name: Almedina (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, green at the hoist and fly and white above and below.
history: The flag of Almedina is green and white forming triangles towards its ends; the arms show a castle on a hill with the Muslim flag and that of the Order of Santiago flying on either side.
